name: overview
description: The overview at the top of the writing companion on Today (v4 C4): one row, ruled off below, no title. The latest weekly reflection's line in the glance's face and size, never wrapping, and a chevron after it; the line and the chevron are the link to that reflection. A line longer than its row fades into the chevron. It must not look like the person's own writing.

first.description: A new account before its first reflection: the line is Today's first-week line and the link opens the week so far; the accessible name says "Your first week" and "See the week so far."

line.description: The latest weekly reflection's line ("Five days here, and sleep on your mind."), or Today's first-week line ("Your first reflection comes on Sunday."). One sentence, about 50 characters at most: a phone's row holds about 50 at 13.5px (390), so a longer line fades. An empty line renders nothing.

dates.description: The reflection's week, "3 to 9 Aug", for the accessible name ("This week, 3 to 9 Aug: …").

href.description: The reflection: the booklet on its first leaf (#reflections), or the week so far for a new account (#reflections-empty).

reflection.description: The reflection's id (its week's Monday, "2026-08-03"), for the seen record: the chevron nudges the first time this id is shown. Without it, no nudge.

labels.description: The accessible name's words: { week: "This week", first: "Your first week", opens: "Opens the reflection.", soFar: "See the week so far." }; these are the defaults.

states.default: yes: the line with a faint dotted underline and the chevron after its last word; a long line fades into the chevron
states.hover: yes: (fine pointer) the chevron leans --g-lean-x toward where it leads and the underline turns solid; reduced motion darkens the chevron to --ink instead
states.focus-visible: yes: the product's ring, with the hover's lean and solid underline
states.active: yes: a new reflection's first showing nudges the chevron once (data-new, set by the script from the seen record)
states.disabled: n/a: shown only when there is a line to open
states.empty: n/a: no line, no overview (renders nothing; the composer is then the plain form)

behaviour.script: overview.js, inside its root only: marks data-over when the line runs over its row (a ResizeObserver on the line, again on document.fonts.ready), so the CSS fades it in place of the ellipsis; sets data-new the first time a reflection's id is shown (the seen record: one value, the last id shown; the account's in the product, the browser's storage here; the motion-review switch ignores it).

data-over.description: The line runs over its row: the fade into the chevron replaces the ellipsis.

data-new.description: This reflection's first showing: the chevron nudges once.

a11y.role: a link (the line and the chevron); the row is not a landmark
a11y.keyboard: Tab to the link; Enter opens the reflection
a11y.labels: aria-label carries the whole line with the week and where it leads ("This week, 3 to 9 Aug: Five days here, and sleep on your mind. Opens the reflection."), so a faded line is never lost; title shows the line on hover

changelog.change: Places its glance by role (line), taking over lock.css's .journal-overview rules and the glance's legacy context.

v4 C4 (explore overview-single-line c-fade-chevron): no label or glance; the latest weekly reflection's line and a chevron, together the link to it (content line, dates, href, reflection, labels; option first); a long line fades into the chevron (overview.js marks data-over; an ellipsis without the script); the chevron leans on hover and focus and nudges once per new reflection (the seen record); 44px tap height on touch; right to left; an empty line renders nothing. The 620px viewport queries go (nothing left to stack).
